title: Acquisitive Podcast Ep 04
description:
Episode 004: Tom Codevilla, Esq

Negotiations are very different around the world. If you're unaware of your counterpart's background and cultural norms, you could end up with bad deal terms... or worse... a failed acquisition. This week we talked to Tom Codevilla, Sara's partner at SK&S Law Group, and got the low down on a tough deal.
